annotation.title_clean: Public Consultation Feedback: Proposed Artificial Intelligence (AI) Governance Bill
annotation.title_en: Public Consultation Feedback: Proposed Artificial Intelligence (AI) Governance Bill
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Digital Malaysia / National AI Office (NAIO)
named_instruments_referenced: ASEAN Guide on AI Governance and Ethics
annotation.summary_en: Malaysian government consultation portal page (National AI Office, Ministry of Digital) for the proposed AI Governance Bill, open 10 July–1 August 2026 at the pre-drafting stage. The Bill would create a central AI authority, principle-based requirements and risk-based regulation. The page lists consultation documents and public comments on interoperability, Sabah's constitutional position, children, ESG and oversight. It has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposed Bill to establish central institutional oversight (Central AI Authority) with sectoral leads
Principle-based national governance requirements and risk-based proportionate regulation
Defines roles and responsibilities of AI actors; proposes AI sandbox and incident reporting
Commenters urge EU AI Act/ASEAN interoperability, safeguards for Sabah/MA63 and indigenous data
Commenters call for child protection, ESG considerations and parliamentary/ombudsman oversight
